content.title: Vodafone to buy German cloud specialist Skaylink for $204 million
content.summary: Britain's Vodafone on Thursday said it will acquire German cloud and digital transformation firm Skaylink for 175 million euros ($204.09 million) from private equity firm Waterland, in a push to expand its service offerings. Skaylink, which has over 500 employees across Germany and Europe, specialises in managing cloud deployments on Microsoft and Amazon Web Services platforms and implementing artificial intelligence solutions for corporate clients. The deal is expected to close by the end of March 2026, subject to regulatory approvals.
